title: Agent Organization v2 · A codecast product proposal
description: A product proposal for an organization of agent sessions in codecast: leads at workspace, project and plan scope, workers at task scope, each understanding the work at its own level, integrated with tasks, plans, projects, docs, chat, decisions and triggers.
kicker: A codecast product proposal · version two · 5 September 2026
headline: An organization of agents
dek: Give the work a brief at every level. From a single task to the whole workspace, an agent knows its scope, keeps a live account of it, answers the questions it is trusted with, and brings you only the ones that are yours.
railNote: Version two. Builds on the version one control plane proposal (pl-519) and designs the product experience it left open. Examples are illustrative unless marked as measured.
